components.x_title: Grid agency price, two-part, 1-10 kV, RMB/kWh

footnote: Source: provincial time-of-use rules, State Grid Jiangsu (Oct 2026) and Guangdong Grid Shantou zone (Sep 2026) price lists. Zhejiang prices worked from No. 112 and Nov 2025 components, indicative only
notes: The bands cover all 24 hours of the day, and the dashed frame marks midday, 10:00 to 14:00, when a rooftop array makes most of its power. October counts as autumn in Jiangsu: 10:00 to 14:00 is off-peak at RMB 0.3828 per kWh, and the peak starts only at 15:00. Zhejiang's Document No. 112 has made 11:00 to 14:00 off-peak all year since 1 July 2026. That row is our own illustration, worked from the November 2025 price components under the new rules, not an official price list. Guangdong still applies its 2021 Document No. 331: 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 19:00 are peak, and July to September add a critical peak at 11:00 to 12:00 and 15:00 to 17:00. So a kWh of rooftop power mostly replaces peak power in Guangdong, while in Jiangsu and Zhejiang the midday hours only replace off-peak power. These are grid agency prices for customers who buy through the grid. They change monthly, and customers on the market should use their own contract. The Guangdong figures are for the Shantou price zone and exclude the five Pearl River Delta cities, whose list we could not obtain.
